title: sigma_org_audit: reliable org-role detection — distinguish CHILD tenant from non-parent/unentitled
description: Current heuristic infers role from /v2/tenants: parent if it lists tenants, standalone if empty, unknown if 403. But a 403 cannot distinguish a CHILD tenant from a non-parent or unentitled org. Confirmed live: test org marko-eutest-mcp is KNOWN to be a child tenant, yet whoami and the member record expose no parent-org or tenant-role field, and /v2/tenants returns 403. Need a reliable signal for child/parent/standalone. Mark owns finding the method (a parent-pointer endpoint, an org-info field, deployment-target lookup, or support guidance). Once known, wire it into the organization role logic and V_TENANCY_TOPOLOGY. Until then the report says role indeterminate and must not assert standalone.
close_reason: Implemented + validated LIVE using Mark's method. Classification: non-empty /v2/tenants => parent; /v2/tenants/{ownOrgId}.parentOrganizationId => child; reachable-empty list => standalone; both 403 => indeterminate. Confirmed live that a CHILD org's own creds are 403 on BOTH /v2/tenants and /v2/tenants/{self}, so a child cannot self-identify via API from inside (matches the product-gap caveat). Added ORG_ROLE_OVERRIDE param (roleSource=operator vs api) so the known role can be recorded authoritatively; ran with override=child -> V_TENANCY_TOPOLOGY now reports 'Child tenant (operator-asserted; API self-lookup denied)'. Captures tenant_self + parentOrganizationId when access permits. The API auto-detect child/parent paths are coded but not live-validatable on this org (no tenant-scope); needs a parent/host org to prove. Deploy gotcha documented: dropping old proc signature required when arg count changes.

title: sigma_org_audit: asset complexity scoring / t-shirt sizing for migration effort (workbooks and data models)

Define a transparent weighted complexity rubric (auditable, provenance-tagged, same pattern as scoring-rubric.md) producing a numeric score bucketed into S/M/L/XL with the top contributing factors shown per asset. Deliver a V_ASSET_COMPLEXITY mart. Frame output as a complexity proxy, not a calibrated time estimate, unless weights are tuned against real migration outcomes. Feeds wave planning when combined with deployability blockers and blast radius (downstream consumer count).

title: sigma_org_audit: deletion/tombstone detection (objects removed in Sigma must stop showing as live)
description: Foundational correctness, affects every object. Append-only plus latest-snapshot-wins means a deleted object keeps showing its last-seen state forever, and SCD2 never closes a vanished key. Add presence-diffing per snapshot so objects absent from the newest snapshot are tombstoned (IS_DELETED plus DELETED_AT) in stage/marts and closed in SCD2. Without this the inventory overcounts and drift misses deletions.

title: sigma_org_audit: capture tenancy and deployment topology (tenants, deployment policies, source-swap policies, parent/child role)

Capture new raw object types: tenant, deployment_policy (plus its files and tenants), source_swap_policy. Add stage views and a topology mart that shows parent-child relationships, what content is deployed to which tenants, and which deployment/source-swap policies exist. whoami already gives organizationId; extend to record the org role.
close_reason: Implemented + validated LIVE. sigma_org_extract now captures tenant, deployment_policy (+detail: per-policy tenants/files), source_swap_policy, and a derived 'organization' row with role (parent/standalone/unknown) + counts; 403 on /v2/tenants is recorded in errors, not fatal. Stage: STG_ORGANIZATION/STG_TENANTS/STG_DEPLOYMENT_POLICIES/STG_SOURCE_SWAP_POLICIES. Mart: V_TENANCY_TOPOLOGY with role + actionable note. Test org marko-eutest-mcp resolves to role=unknown (tenant enum 403), 0 deployment + 0 source-swap policies = standalone, not a configured parent. LIMITATION: populated parent/tenant case not validatable on this org (no entitlement) — only the standalone/denied path is live-proven; tenant/policy stage views pass raw payload through until a populated org is available.

title: writeback_info_dbx: rework archival_scoring — separate archivability from reclamation/migration, fix STATUS ladder, route orphaned to dangling-cleanup, de-duplicate via a view

Changes: STATUS re-weighted — IS_DELETED top (40, data table still present = clean reclaim), API_IS_ARCHIVED down to 15 + flagged reversible, absent-from-API to 10 + guarded on WORKBOOK_ID and caveated as a possible enrichment gap; IS_ORPHANED removed from scoring and routed to a separate dangling-WAL/stale-record cleanup query (nothing to quarantine); storage removed from score → SIGDS_TABLE_SIZE_MB column + sort tie-breaker; legacy-WAL removed from score → MIGRATION_PRIORITY flag; WAL recency raised to 35 (primary signal); NULL flags hardened with COALESCE; scoring consolidated into a single SIGDS_ARCHIVAL_SCORED view so the candidate list and rollup can't drift. close_reason: Merged in PR #10 (Databricks run still pending to confirm SQL executes). description: get_sigma_token and sigma_paginate (lines ~182-226) have no retry; a transient 429/5xx aborts the whole scheduled run via raise_for_status. Add a requests.Session with a urllib3 Retry adapter (backoff on 429/5xx, respect Retry-After) — improves resilience and pools connections across the many paginated calls. Biggest reliability win.

title: writeback_info_dbx (C1): bind MERGE rows to columns by name to remove positional tuple↔MERGE_SCHEMA coupling
description: The 32-field row tuple (src/populate_sigds_workbook_map.py ~820-853) is built positionally and zipped to MERGE_SCHEMA (~377-412) by order. Reordering/inserting a field in one but not the other silently misaligns data (same-typed columns won't raise). Fix: construct Row/dict per record keyed by column name (or createDataFrame from dicts) so order can't drift. Highest-value hardening — removes a silent-corruption trap.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #4 (merged to main): MERGE rows now built as name-keyed dicts, tuples generated in MERGE_SCHEMA field order with a fail-fast guard on key/column mismatch. Removes the positional tuple↔schema drift risk. py_compile clean; ordering+guard unit-checked standalone.

title: sigma_org_audit: writeback governance over-attributes a shared writeback schema to one org (false orphans / inflated storage)
description: Live finding: MARKO_WB.MARKO_WB is a Snowflake writeback schema SHARED by multiple Sigma orgs (marko-eutest, marko-eutest-mcp=our extracted org, others). sigma_writeback_scan attributes every SIGDS/WAL table in a schema to whichever single org's connection discovered it, so all 123 tables were attributed to our org. True ownership (from WAL workbook URL slug): only 4 are ours (1 orphaned), 60 belong to marko-eutest, 56 have no WAL url, 3 malformed. Result: 119 false-orphans and massively inflated reclaimable storage for our org. FIX: attribute each SIGDS table to its true owning org using the WAL workbook URL slug / workbook_id matched against that org's live workbooks; compute orphan/governance only within the correct org; flag connections whose writeback schema is shared across orgs; segregate cross-org and no-url tables instead of counting them as this org's orphans.
close_reason: Fixed + validated LIVE (view-layer only, rebuilt from existing raw, no re-scan). STG_WRITEBACK_TABLES now derives true owner via org-agnostic workbook_id match (OWNING_ORG_ID) + WAL url slug (WAL_ORG_SLUG). V_WRITEBACK_GOVERNANCE classifies each table ATTRIBUTION = OWNED/ORPHANED/CROSS_ORG/UNATTRIBUTED; only ORPHANED counts toward archival score + reclaimable. New V_WRITEBACK_SHARED_SCHEMAS flags shared schemas. Result on test org: 119 false-orphans -> 1 genuine (CROSS_ORG 63, UNATTRIBUTED 55, OWNED 4, ORPHANED 1); MARKO_WB.MARKO_WB correctly flagged shared across 3 org slugs. audit_queries + README updated. NOTE: skill scoring-rubric.md should document ATTRIBUTION (fold into jen).

title: sigma_org_audit: sigma_writeback_scan misses co-located WAL tables; when inputTableAuditLogSchema is null, also scan each writeback location for SIGDS_WAL tables. Root cause of su8 orphan over-firing (WAL tables exist in MARKO_WB.MARKO_WB but were skipped).
notes: DOC-GROUNDED DESIGN (verified via Sigma help docs): per 'Set up write access', the write-access destination schema is reserved for ALL internal write-back objects; per 'View input table audit history', the audit log is the view INPUT_TABLE_AUDIT_LOG_<id> co-located in the SAME database.schema as the SIGDS_ input table. So the writeback location IS the authoritative WAL location. inputTableAuditLogSchema API field is unreliable (null on all 3 test-org connections despite SIGDS_WAL_* tables present in the writeback schema MARKO_WB.MARKO_WB). FIX: make scanning the writeback location(s) for SIGDS_WAL* the PRIMARY path; treat inputTableAuditLogSchema as a supplementary location scanned only if set and distinct (union+dedupe). Validate live: MARKO_WB.MARKO_WB is reachable with real WAL tables.
close_reason: Fixed + validated LIVE. sigma_writeback_scan now scans each writeback location for SIGDS_WAL* as the primary path (inputTableAuditLogSchema demoted to supplementary, deduped). Also fixed a JSON-serialization bug surfaced by the now-active WAL path: SIGDS_WAL DS_ID is BINARY (bytearray) -> added _jsonable() coercion (bytes->utf8/hex, Decimal->num). Re-run: writeback_wal 0->120, 119 tables now have WAL activity, 4 mapped to live workbook. README/api docs updated.
